s0202.literal: " Concerning Prince Buliyadun's rebellion, princes Yeshe and Shilijhi and guard officers Duodai and Baidu were convicted of straddling both sides and not assisting the official armies in the punitive campaign; an edict banished Yeshe to Jiangxi, Shilijhi to Huguang, Duodai to Hengzhou, and Baidu to Tanzhou.
s0202.idiomatic: " Concerning Prince Buliyadun's rebellion, princes Yeshe and Shilijhi and guard officers Duodai and Baidu were convicted of straddling both sides and not assisting the official armies in the punitive campaign; an edict banished Yeshe to Jiangxi, Shilijhi to Huguang, Duodai to Hengzhou, and Baidu to Tanzhou.

s0203.literal: On guiyou day Prince Wei Amuge's princely tutor's seal was confiscated.
s0203.idiomatic: On guiyou day Prince Wei Amuge's princely tutor's seal was confiscated.

s0204.literal: The Fodder and Granary Bureau was established, rank primary eighth grade, subordinate to the Shangdu Guard Commission.
s0204.idiomatic: The Fodder and Granary Bureau was established, rank primary eighth grade, subordinate to the Shangdu Guard Commission.

s0205.literal: A patrol office was established at Shiquan post station, Feng Prefecture.
s0205.idiomatic: A patrol office was established at Shiquan post station, Feng Prefecture.

s0206.literal: Princes Bieship Temür and others were granted gold and silver, and their followings were also relieved with ten thousand shi of grain and ten thousand ingots of notes.
s0206.idiomatic: Princes Bieship Temür and others were granted gold and silver, and their followings were also relieved with 10,000 shi of grain and 10,000 ingots of notes.

s0207.literal: On jimao day princes Yongjiladai and Quchun Temür came to court and were granted two hundred taels of gold, one thousand taels of silver, five thousand ingots of notes, and one hundred bolts of silks and cloths; notes and grain were additionally granted to be distributed among their followings.
s0207.idiomatic: On jimao day princes Yongjiladai and Quchun Temür came to court and were granted 200 taels of gold, 1,000 taels of silver, 5,000 ingots of notes, and 100 bolts of silks and cloths; notes and grain were additionally granted to be distributed among their followings.

s0208.literal: On xinsi day the Receipt-and-Issue Storehouse was established, rank ninth grade, subordinate to the Works Ministry.
s0208.idiomatic: On xinsi day the Receipt-and-Issue Storehouse was established, rank ninth grade, subordinate to the Works Ministry.

s0209.literal: On renwu day land seized from common people by Henan left associate administrator Chen Ying and others was abolished; tax was to be paid only according to the old precedent.
s0209.idiomatic: On renwu day land seized from common people by Henan left associate administrator Chen Ying and others was abolished; tax was to be paid only according to the old precedent.

s0210.literal: On wuzi day mountains collapsed in Ningyuan County, Gongchang Route.
s0210.idiomatic: On wuzi day mountains collapsed in Ningyuan County, Gongchang Route.

s0211.literal: Qu Yuan, Grand Master of the Three Wards of Chu, was additionally enfeoffed Duke of Loyal Integrity and Pure Valor.
s0211.idiomatic: Qu Yuan, Grand Master of the Three Wards of Chu, was additionally enfeoffed Duke of Loyal Integrity and Pure Valor.

s0212.literal: Eighth month, on wuzi day the imperial carriage arrived from Shangdu.
s0212.idiomatic: Eighth month, on wuzi day the imperial carriage arrived from Shangdu.

s0213.literal: On yimao day Wengyuan County was merged into Qujiang County.
s0213.idiomatic: On yimao day Wengyuan County was merged into Qujiang County.

s0214.literal: Ninth month, on guihai day Minister of Agriculture Maizhu and others presented Illustrations and Explanations of Mulberry Planting by vice director of the Ministry of Agriculture Miao Haoqian; the Emperor said: "Agriculture and sericulture are the root of clothing and food; this illustrated work is very good.
s0214.idiomatic: Ninth month, on guihai day Minister of Agriculture Maizhu and others presented Illustrations and Explanations of Mulberry Planting by vice director of the Ministry of Agriculture Miao Haoqian; the Emperor said, "Agriculture and sericulture are the root of clothing and food; this illustrated work is very good.

s0215.literal: " An order directed that one thousand fascicles be printed and distributed among the people.
s0215.idiomatic: " An order directed that 1,000 fascicles be printed and distributed among the people.

s0216.literal: On bingyin day Zhao Qingchen, wanhu commander of Long Prefecture in Guangxi's Two Rivers region, and Li Xinglong, overall controller of Taiping Route, led native officials Huang Fafu and He Kai — all came to tribute with local products; silks and cloths were granted in varying amounts.
s0216.idiomatic: On bingyin day Zhao Qingchen, wanhu commander of Long Prefecture in Guangxi's Two Rivers region, and Li Xinglong, overall controller of Taiping Route, led native officials Huang Fafu and He Kai — all came to tribute with local products; silks and cloths were granted in varying amounts.

s0217.literal: Prince of Bin Nanhuli and others' followings were impoverished; Gansu Province was ordered to purchase ten thousand horses to supply them.
s0217.idiomatic: Prince of Bin Nanhuli and others' followings were impoverished; Gansu Province was ordered to purchase 10,000 horses to supply them.

s0218.literal: On dingmao day central secretariat right vice chancellor and palace domestic service commissioner Yiliechi was made central secretariat grand councillor; left associate administrator Gao Fang was made right vice chancellor; associate administrator Huanzhu was made left associate administrator; minister of personnel director Yanzigan was made associate administrator.
s0218.idiomatic: On dingmao day central secretariat right vice chancellor and palace domestic service commissioner Yiliechi was made central secretariat grand councillor; left associate administrator Gao Fang was made right vice chancellor; associate administrator Huanzhu was made left associate administrator; minister of personnel director Yanzigan was made associate administrator.

s0219.literal: On renshen day notes were issued to the northern frontier armies as horse-price payment.
s0219.idiomatic: On renshen day notes were issued to the northern frontier armies as horse-price payment.

s0220.literal: On jiaxu day, on account of Buddhist rites, three prisoners under heavy sentence and fifty-three under light sentence were released.
s0220.idiomatic: On jiaxu day, on account of Buddhist rites, 3 prisoners under heavy sentence and 53 under light sentence were released.

s0221.literal: On jimao day fifty copies of Extension of the Great Learning printed by Jiang-Zhe Province were granted to court officials.
s0221.idiomatic: On jimao day 50 copies of Extension of the Great Learning printed by Jiang-Zhe Province were granted to court officials.

s0222.literal: On xinsi day the Overall Regulatory Bureau of the Great Eternal Blessings Monastery was established, rank third grade.
s0222.idiomatic: On xinsi day the Overall Regulatory Bureau of the Great Eternal Blessings Monastery was established, rank third grade.

s0223.literal: On renwu day an edict directed: "When military officers commit crimes, branch secretariats shall consult the Privy Council for deliberation; they must not adjudicate and dispatch on their own.
s0223.idiomatic: On renwu day an edict directed, "When military officers commit crimes, branch secretariats shall consult the Privy Council for deliberation; they must not adjudicate and dispatch on their own.

s0224.idiomatic: " On bingxu day commissary of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices Gou'er was made central secretariat associate administrator.

s0225.literal: On dinghai day a Branch Bureau of Buddhist Affairs was established at Hangzhou, with eight officials.
s0225.idiomatic: On dinghai day a Branch Bureau of Buddhist Affairs was established at Hangzhou, with 8 officials.

s0226.literal: Jincheng County, Datong Route, suffered heavy hail.
s0226.idiomatic: Jincheng County, Datong Route, suffered heavy hail.

s0227.idiomatic: Winter, tenth month, on jichou day Daning Route was subordinated to Liaoyang Province and Xande Prefecture to Dadu Route.

s0228.literal: An edict directed: "For monks, apart from land held since Song times and land granted by the court which is exempt from rent and tax, remaining land shall be taxed on the same basis as civilians.
s0228.idiomatic: An edict directed, "For monks, apart from land held since Song times and land granted by the court which is exempt from rent and tax, remaining land shall be taxed on the same basis as civilians.

s0229.literal: " Nannan district commander Luomo of Bozhou caused disorder; the Sizhou defending official Huanzhuge summoned him, and Luomo sent envoys with local products to have an audience.
s0229.idiomatic: " Nannan district commander Luomo of Bozhou caused disorder; the Sizhou defending official Huanzhuge summoned him, and Luomo sent envoys with local products to have an audience.

s0230.idiomatic: The salt transport commissions of Jiao, Lai, Ju, and Mi were abolished and Taoluo station was re-established.

s0231.literal: On xinmao day wine-brewing was forbidden in Datong, Jining, Jinning, and other routes.
s0231.idiomatic: On xinmao day wine-brewing was forbidden in Datong, Jining, Jinning, and other routes.

s0232.literal: On renchen day a hall for Imperial Preceptor 'Phags-pa was built at the Great Promoting Teaching Monastery; ten thousand ingots of notes were granted.
s0232.idiomatic: On renchen day a hall for Imperial Preceptor 'Phags-pa was built at the Great Promoting Teaching Monastery; 10,000 ingots of notes were granted.

s0233.idiomatic: On guisi day the Central Guard Prefecture was changed to the Yulin Imperial Guard Command.

s0234.literal: On jiawu day sacrifice was performed at the Grand Ancestral Temple.
s0234.idiomatic: On jiawu day sacrifice was performed at the Grand Ancestral Temple.

s0235.literal: On guichou day Liu Jingzhou, a village clerk of Yudu County, Ganzhou Route, gathered a mob and caused disorder because officials were collecting newly assessed land rent; an edict exempted the new rent and sent summons.
s0235.idiomatic: On guichou day Liu Jingzhou, a village clerk of Yudu County, Ganzhou Route, gathered a mob and caused disorder because officials were collecting newly assessed land rent; an edict exempted the new rent and sent summons.

s0236.literal: Eleventh month, on xinyou day wine was forbidden in Kaicheng, Zhuanglang, and other places.
s0236.idiomatic: Eleventh month, on xinyou day wine was forbidden in Kaicheng, Zhuanglang, and other places.

s0237.literal: On renxu day the Yellow Flower Ridge Garrison Storage Military-Civilian Overall Regulatory Bureau was changed to the Garrison Storage Overall Regulatory Bureau, with four officials.
s0237.idiomatic: On renxu day the Yellow Flower Ridge Garrison Storage Military-Civilian Overall Regulatory Bureau was changed to the Garrison Storage Overall Regulatory Bureau, with 4 officials.

s0238.literal: The people north of the mountains were famished; sea transport grain was increased by four hundred thousand shi.
s0238.idiomatic: The people north of the mountains were famished; sea transport grain was increased by 400,000 shi.

s0239.literal: Commanders of the southern and northern metropolitan horse-and-cavalry commissions were increased — two each for semuren and Han Chinese; two branch-office seals were issued.
s0239.idiomatic: Commanders of the southern and northern metropolitan horse-and-cavalry commissions were increased — 2 each for semuren and Han Chinese; 2 branch-office seals were issued.

s0240.literal: On dingmao day, acting on the memorial of surveillance censor Naimandai and others, commoners Wang Xun of Jiankang and others who had received commissions without office were stripped of their illicitly bestowed edicts; it was further forbidden for men to enter palace guard service under false household registration, artfully accept distant posts and not take up office while seeking transfer elsewhere — those who concealed themselves and did not confess would be punished.
s0240.idiomatic: On dingmao day, acting on the memorial of surveillance censor Naimandai and others, commoners Wang Xun of Jiankang and others who had received commissions without office were stripped of their illicitly bestowed edicts; it was further forbidden for men to enter palace guard service under false household registration, artfully accept distant posts and not take up office while seeking transfer elsewhere — those who concealed themselves and did not confess would be punished.

s0241.idiomatic: On jisi day associate privy council administrator Zhongjia was promoted privy council administrator.

s0242.literal: On bingzi day grand academician of the Academy of Scholarly Worthies and Grand Tutor Quchu said: "Tang Lu Chun wrote Collected Examples, Doubts Examined, and Subtle Intent — three works on the Spring and Autumn Annals that benefit later students; please order the Jiangxi branch secretariat to block-print them to broaden circulation.
s0242.idiomatic: On bingzi day grand academician of the Academy of Scholarly Worthies and Grand Tutor Quchu said, "Tang Lu Chun wrote Collected Examples, Doubts Examined, and Subtle Intent — 3 works on the Spring and Autumn Annals that benefit later students; please order the Jiangxi branch secretariat to block-print them to broaden circulation.

s0244.idiomatic: On guimao day the Jiangxi Tea Transport Commission's annual quota was fixed at 250,000 ingots.

s0245.literal: An edict directed construction of a hall at the Great Eternal Blessings Monastery to enshrine the portrait of Emperor Shunzong.
s0245.idiomatic: An edict directed construction of a hall at the Great Eternal Blessings Monastery to enshrine the portrait of Emperor Shunzong.

s0246.idiomatic: Twelfth month, on renchen day grand academician of the Academy of Scholarly Worthies Tuoilie was specially granted Grand Tutor.

s0247.idiomatic: On xinhai day garrison-farm was established at Jiangjin, Ba County, and other places in Chongqing Route, saving 12,000 shi of Chengdu's annual canal transport.

s0248.idiomatic: On jiayin day the Privy Council was directed to verify impoverished Mongol soldiers and provide care for 5 years.

s0249.idiomatic: Sixth year, spring, first month, on dingsi new moon, Siam sent envoys presenting a memorial and tribute goods.

s0250.literal: On dingmao day an edict directed: "When military officers of Fujian, the Two Guang, Yunnan, Gansu, and Sichuan retire and return home, the government shall provide relay transport as for civilian officials.

s0251.idiomatic: " On wuchen day the impoverished commoners of Prince of Jin's following were relieved.

s0252.idiomatic: On guiyou day Branch Palace Domestic Service Commission associate administrator Choulü Darqan was specially granted Grand Master of the Golden Seal and Purple Ribbon and Grand Commandant; a silver seal was granted.

s0253.literal: On jiaxu day surveillance censor Bolu Chong and others said: "The Crown Prince rightly occupies the Eastern Palace; since the Crown Prince Household Court has been established to oversee household affairs, it is fitting to select men of advanced years, settled virtue, and lofty moral standing as tutors, protectors, and advisers, that they may devote themselves to guiding him and broaden his accumulated illumination in learning.
s0253.idiomatic: On jiaxu day surveillance censor Bolu Chong and others said, "The Crown Prince rightly occupies the Eastern Palace; since the Crown Prince Household Court has been established to oversee household affairs, it is fitting to select men of advanced years, settled virtue, and lofty moral standing as tutors, protectors, and advisers, that they may devote themselves to guiding him and broaden his accumulated illumination in learning.

s0255.literal: " On wuyin day the moon encroached upon Heart.
s0255.idiomatic: " On wuyin day the moon encroached upon Heart.

s0256.literal: On jimao day sacrifice to the stars was performed at the Bureau of Astronomy.
s0256.idiomatic: On jimao day sacrifice to the stars was performed at the Bureau of Astronomy.

s0257.idiomatic: Yao bandits Long Langgeng and others of Nan'en and Xin Prefectures in Guangdong raided; the Jiangxi branch secretariat was ordered to dispatch troops to capture them.

s0258.literal: The Emperor, holding court at the Jiaxi Hall, told the jail commissioner Maimaiyun: "The jail commissioner's office bears on human lives; examine case records in detail; whether matters are great or small, always consult fellow officials; where doubt cannot be resolved, assemble with secretariat and censorate officials to deliberate and report.
s0258.idiomatic: The Emperor, holding court at the Jiaxi Hall, told the jail commissioner Maimaiyun, "The jail commissioner's office bears on human lives; examine case records in detail; whether matters are great or small, always consult fellow officials; where doubt cannot be resolved, assemble with secretariat and censorate officials to deliberate and report.

s0259.idiomatic: " He also turned to tell attendant officials, "Do you all consider that I am secure in holding the imperial throne?

s0260.literal: I reflect that the Founding Emperor's enterprise was hard-won, and the Shizu Emperor unified the realm; diligently keeping what was achieved, I ever fear I cannot accord with Heaven's heart and follow the ancestral pattern, so that the people of ten thousand directions may each find their place — my cares are here, which you all surely do not know."
s0260.idiomatic: I reflect that the Founding Emperor's enterprise was hard-won, and the Shizu Emperor unified the realm; diligently keeping what was achieved, I ever fear I cannot accord with Heaven's heart and follow the ancestral pattern, so that the people of ten thousand directions may each find their place — my cares are here, which you all surely do not know."

s0261.idiomatic: Second month, on dinghai new moon, there was a solar eclipse.

s0266.idiomatic: On jihai day the moon encroached upon Lingtai.

s0268.literal: " Monk Congjixiang was specially granted Grand Master for Glorious Blessings and Grand Minister of Works; monk Wenjixiang was additionally made Grand Master for Glorious Blessings, Grand Tutor, and Commissioner with the Ceremonial Standing Equal to the Three Excellencies.

s0270.idiomatic: On yiwei day notes were issued to relieve Shangdu and Western Regions relay stations.

s0273.literal: You must reflect on your grandfathers' and fathers' loyal diligence toward the royal house, and still take ancient exemplary ministers as your model — otherwise you will bring down your family's reputation and betray the trust of my commission.

s0274.idiomatic: " On bingyin day Huaide Route was redesignated Huaqing Route.

s0281.idiomatic: On jiaxu day the moon encroached upon Heart.

s0287.idiomatic: " On bingchen day officials and clerks of the capital's various offices were ordered to transport grain to Shangdu and Xinghe to relieve famished Mongols.

s0288.idiomatic: On gengzi day the imperial carriage proceeded to Shangdu.

s0289.idiomatic: Tiemudie'er was made crown prince grand preceptor.

s0294.idiomatic: Fifth month, on xinyou day the moon encroached upon Lingtai.
